Profile Midecamycin is a macrolide antibacterial produced by the growth of Streptomyces mycarofaciens with actions and uses similar to those of erythromycin (p.269) but it is somewhat less active. It is given orally for the treatment of susceptible infections as the acetate in usual doses of 0.9 to 1.8 g daily in 2 or 3 divided doses. It has also been given as the base.
